core_obligations: Part (1) (proof lines 939-962): rephrase as a(O_Spec(k)) = a'(O_Spec(k')) for the two structure morphisms; finiteness of k'/k, uniqueness of adjoints giving a = a' composed with the right adjoint of Spec(k') -> Spec(k) (i.e. f^! = (f')^! g^!), and the dimension-one identification Hom_k(k', k) = k' as k'-modules finish the recheck.
Part (2) (proof lines 963-965): pullback compatibility is exactly the base change theorem for a, as discussed in the relative dualizing remark.
proof_roadmap: Reformulate property (1) as equality of the two twisted inverse images of the structure sheaves.
Decompose f^! through the intermediate field using uniqueness of adjoints.
Verify the remaining factor by the affine Hom identification of equal-dimensional vector spaces.
Derive part (2) directly from base change for the adjoint.

Every step is present with no omissions. H2: a short reference chain whose hinges are correctly ordered, with one genuine dimension argument.
